# dsh-rea
English | 简体中文 · Releases · Changelog

> **Unofficial.** This repository is an independent DeepSeek Harness bundle. It is
> not affiliated

with, endorsed by, or published by the REA project. It contains
> no REA source code: at runtime it

installs the official
> `rea-agents` package from npm and
> connects its MCP server to the Harness.

> connects its MCP server to the Harness. See NOTICE.md.

A configuration-only DeepSeek Harness
bundle that connects the REA reverse-engineering MCP server. O

nce installed, the
agent can call REA tools as `mcp__rea__<tool>` — inspect native binaries, app
bun

dles, JavaScript/Electron applications, managed assemblies, websites, packet
captures, firmware imag
es, and runtime behavior.
## Origin and provenance

- **Upstream project:** REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
by **morluto**, MIT-licensed. The npm packag

e is
`rea-agents`; documentation lives at
rea.tools.
- **This repository:** <https://github.com/sqhc

/dsh-rea>, maintained by
sqhc. It is a packaging layer, not a fork.
- **Relationship:** unofficial i

ntegration. It turns the `rea-mcp` registration
that REA's own `rea setup --client dsh` writes into

an installable DSH bundle
with locale metadata and an icon. No REA source code, binaries, or artwork

are
copied; the official package is fetched from npm at runtime.
- **Packaging contract:** DeepSeek

Harness's `dsh.bundle.patch` format and the
harness-shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`.

ess on the first launch so `npx` can fetch `rea-agents@6.7.0`.

## Release Notes

**Changes**
- Upstream REA updated from 6.7.0 → 6.8.0
- Tool count: 207 → **229** (+22 new tools: Ag
ent Environments, GPU/BEAM/Python/Unity/Godot/Node.js SEA/devicetree, PE/ELF deep inspection, Retain

ed Summaries)
- Catalog size: 214 KiB → **295 KiB** (+38%)
- Max schema (`inspect_analysis_view`): 7

.4 KB → **15.2 KB** (2×)
- Node.js engine requirement tightened: **22.23.4+ / 24.22.1+ / 26.12.1+**

(Node 23/25 explicitly unsupported)
- Bundle size: 28 MB → 49 MB (first `npx` download slower)

**Migration**
1. Update `cordis.patch.yml`: `rea-agents@6.8.0`
2. Ensure Node.js ≥ 24.22.1 (or 22.23

.4 / 26.12.1) on the Harness PATH
3. Reinstall/reload bundle and run `node scripts/preflight.mjs`

**Known risks**
- Windows: untested (known limitation)
- Node 24.21.x will fail preflight — upgrade

Node or pin to 22.23.4+
- Catalog token cost ~76k tokens (compact input); disable bundle when not re

.23.4+
- Catalog token cost ~76k tokens (compact input); disable bundle when not reverse-engineering
## Install

Clone this repository, then ask the Harness agent to install the bundle
directory with `plugin_manag

er` (`action: install_bundle`). The agent needs the
absolute path to the checkout. Installing change

s the current DSH profile and
survives restarts.
Before installing, you can run the preflight script:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

It checks the Node version and npm cache, performs an MCP initialize +
`tools/list` handshake agains

t `rea-agents@6.7.0`, and reports the tool count and
catalog size. It also warms the npx cache, whic

h makes the first Harness launch
much faster.
## First launch

The first launch may take a while because `npx` downloads REA. The bundle starts
with `failOnStartup

Error: false` and automatic reconnect, so a slow first
download does not disable the row; calls fail

until the server is ready. Check
the Harness log if no REA tools appear after a few minutes.
## Verify

Ask the agent to call `mcp__rea__binary_session` with no arguments. It reports
the current target/pr

ovider/server identity without starting analysis. A healthy
result identifies the REA server version

er identity without starting analysis. A healthy
result identifies the REA server version (`6.7.0`).
## Limitations

- MCP prompt templates are not supported by `dsh-mcp-client`; REA's six guided
prompts are not expos

ed through this bundle. Tools work normally.
- `dsh-mcp-client` exposes tools only after discovery;

a crashed npx child keeps
the last tool set listed until reconnect exhausts its budget.
- REA native

providers (Hopper, Ghidra, IDA, JADX, Frida, …) require their own
installations. The bundle does no

t install or license them.
- Windows behavior is untested here.
## Security and legal

REA analyzes local artifacts and can launch external helper programs. Only use it
on software you ar

e authorized to inspect, and review REA's own
DISCLAIMER and
SECURITY policies. This
bundle adds no
telemetry and stores no credentials.

REA is MIT-licensed by its authors. This repository's configuration, docs, and
artwork are MIT-licen
sed as well; see LICENSE and NOTICE.md.
